title: Evaluator briefs under byte pressure can drop the only passed verification record a bound criterion could cite
outcome:
Low and Note from the Claude reviewer of w-51dab1c2faab, round 2 (delegation-1baa0871-deae-4599-89cc-90823ec063e9).

(1) The same-session Compact verification list (src/acceptance_evaluation.rs, acceptance_same_session_verifications) keeps the 4 newest records of a bound kind whatever their result. Failed or indeterminate records can therefore push out the only passed record a bound criterion could cite.

(2) Under budget pressure, the independent brief leaves out entries oldest-first, with no preference for passed verification records of a bound kind. The left-out inventory does not mark which entries were verification records, and the evaluator may call no tracker tool.

Either way the evaluator sees no admissible citation and may downgrade to insufficient-evidence.
acceptance: At Compact detail the same-session list prefers passed records of a bound kind, filling with others only to the limit; a test where the newest bound-kind records failed covers it.
When the independent brief leaves out evidence, passed verification records of a bound kind are kept listed longest, or are marked as such in the left-out inventory; a test covers it.
